newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan business outlook improves - BOJ survey.
newsitem.headline: Japan business outlook improves - BOJ survey.

text.p: Major Japanese manufacturing firms grew cheerier in June and remained significantly more optimistic than their non-manufacturing colleagues, the Bank of Japan's closely watched "tankan" quarterly survey of corporate sentiment showed on Wednesday.

The diffusion index for manufacturers, a key gauge of business confidence, rose to plus seven in June from plus two in March, when the previous survey was conducted. In March, the survey had forecast a manufacturers' diffusion index of minus one for June.

The business diffusion index, a key gauge of corporate sentiment, measures the percentage of firms that expect their business environment to improve minus the percentage that expect it to worsen. The survey covered 9,469 companies, of which 708 were categorised as large.
